message.content: Helios recommends several games that fit the criteria of having great storylines, character development, and tactical gameplay. Initially, Helios suggests "XCOM 2," highlighting its tactical gameplay and rewarding strategic plans. Helios further recommends "Fire Emblem," describing it as a game that not only offers strategic gameplay but also provides rich character development and a compelling story. This recommendation aligns well with Helios’s interests and the discussions around character depth and narrative complexity.
